Until Iron Man the row shows only 'The Strategic Scientific Reserve'. Should a S.H.I.E.L.D. stage start earlier?
options: Keep as is (stage at Iron Man, where the full name is first said)
Add a stage 'S.H.I.E.L.D.' at Agent Carter (One-Shot), keep the full-name stage at Iron Man
Move the S.H.I.E.L.D. stage to Agent Carter (One-Shot)
evidence: Agent Carter (One-Shot): Stark tells Flynn that Carter is to run S.H.I.E.L.D. with him (S.H.I.E.L.D. mentioned). Stage 1 itself is true from Iron Man on and is not early, so it passes; the question is whether stage 0 runs too long.

question: Stage 2 ('Active. Fisk in prison', from Daredevil S3) runs until Daredevil: Born Again S1, but in this box's order Hawkeye and Echo come in between, and there Fisk is out of prison (acquitted in 2018, running the Tracksuit Mafia, shot by Maya and recovering in Echo). How do you want the row to cover Hawkeye and Echo?
options: Add a stage at Hawkeye: 'Active. Fisk free again, back running crime'
Trim stage 2 to 'Active' so it holds through Hawkeye and Echo
Keep as is (the row tracks only what Daredevil titles show)
evidence: Wilson Fisk (MCU) article, 'After the Blip': in 2018 Fisk is acquitted after the FBI corruption scandal and rebuilds his empire with the Tracksuit Mafia; Hawkeye (Dec 2024) has him free until Maya shoots him; Echo (2025) has him recovering and returning to New York. So 'Fisk in prison' is not true from Hawkeye until Born Again S1.
